* Lite interface that generated extensions implement. * *

Methods are for use by generated code only. You can hold a reference to extensions using this * type name.

methods.name: public abstract int getNumber()
methods.comment: Returns the field number of the extension.

methods.name: public abstract WireFormat.FieldType getLiteType()
methods.comment: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isRepeated()
methods.comment: Returns whether it is a repeated field.

methods.name: public abstract Type getDefaultValue()
methods.comment: Returns the default value of the extension field.

methods.name: public abstract MessageLite getMessageDefaultInstance()
methods.comment: Returns the default instance of the extension field, if it's a message extension.

methods.name: boolean isLite()
methods.comment: Returns whether or not this extension is a Lite Extension.
